hybrid_tapleaf.description: Two-round signing for hybrid tapleaf (SPHINCS+ then Schnorr)
steps: 1. SPHINCS+ signer: compute BIP 369 sighash (BIP 342 minus sha_annex, spend_type=0x03)
2. SPHINCS+ signer: produce 4080-byte signature via SphincsSign
4. Schnorr signer: compute BIP 342 sighash (includes sha_annex from step 3)
hybrid_tapleaf.note: Public keys are data pushes inside the script, NOT separate witness elements

keypath_bip368.description: Single-round key-path signing with BIP 368 annex
steps: 1. Build deterministic annex from internal key P (and optional merkle_root)

witness_layouts.note: Annex is always last witness element, identified by 0x50 prefix
